title: The Doctor Who Used Patients as Human Incubators for His Own Baby
hook: A fertility specialist secretly implanted his own sperm into dozens of women without their knowledge or consent.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines shock, betrayal, and the ultimate violation of bodily autonomy—perfect for outrage-driven shares.

title: The Suppressed Cure: How a $3 Iodine Solution Killed 95% of Tumors
hook: Decades of research showed it worked—but it was buried because it couldn't be patented.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'patent vs cure' narrative is evergreen and triggers deep anger at the pharmaceutical industry.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Sold a Diabetes Drug That Made Patients Go Blind
hook: They knew the drug caused permanent vision loss—but they hid the data for years to keep profits flowing.
why_this_can_go_viral: Blindness is a visceral fear, and the corporate cover-up angle fuels anti-pharma sentiment.

title: The Suppressed Cure: How a $1 Magnet Stopped 80% of Stroke Damage
hook: A simple magnetic field reversed brain damage in minutes—but no hospital will use it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The contrast between 'cheap and effective' vs 'expensive and ignored' is a powerful conspiracy-friendly narrative.

title: The Hospital That Used Patients as Medical Training Dummies—While They Were Awake
hook: Unconscious patients weren't—they were paralyzed but fully aware as doctors practiced on them.
why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate nightmare scenario—being trapped inside your own body—guarantees visceral horror clicks.

title: The Toxic Cookware That Gave Families Alzheimer's
hook: It was marketed as non-stick and safe—but the chemical coating slowly destroyed their brains.
why_this_can_go_viral: Everyone has non-stick pans—this makes the danger feel immediate and personal, driving urgent shares.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How a Fungus in Coffee Caused a Parkinson's Epidemic
hook: The tremor in your hands might not be aging—it might be a mold that's been in your morning cup for decades.
why_this_can_go_viral: Coffee is universal—implicating it in a devastating disease makes people stop and pay attention.

title: The Doctor Who Gave Patients Leprosy—On Purpose
hook: He injected healthy people with leprosy bacteria to 'study' how it spread, then watched them rot.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer horror of intentionally giving someone leprosy is unforgettable and share-worthy.

title: The Suppressed Cure: How a $5 Parasite Worm Stopped 90% of Autoimmune Disease
hook: Scientists found that hookworms could cure multiple sclerosis—but the FDA blocked human trials.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'gross but effective' angle plus the conspiracy of suppression creates high curiosity.

title: The Toxic Air Freshener That Gave Children Asthma—For Life
hook: It made your house smell like a meadow—but it was chemically scarring children's lungs permanently.
why_this_can_go_viral: Almost every home uses these products—making the danger feel immediate and personal.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How a Virus in Chicken Meat Caused 40% of Female Infertility
hook: Doctors blamed 'unknown causes' for millions of infertility cases—but the answer was in the poultry aisle.
why_this_can_go_viral: Infertility is a deeply emotional topic—finding a hidden cause in everyday food is explosively shareable.

title: The Hospital That Chained Mental Patients to Walls for 50 Years
hook: They were forgotten by society, locked in basements, and fed through floorboards like animals.
why_this_can_go_viral: The imagery of humans treated as animals is deeply disturbing and drives morbid curiosity shares.

title: The Suppressed Cure: How a $10 Salt Bath Reversed 70% of Skin Cancer
hook: Doctors in the 1920s cured melanoma with nothing but brine—then the treatment was erased from history.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'cheap natural cure buried by pharma' narrative is one of the most viral frameworks in health content.

title: The Toxic Shampoo That Gave Women Scalp Cancer
hook: It promised shiny, beautiful hair—instead, it slowly gave them tumors where the chemicals touched.
why_this_can_go_viral: Beauty products are universally used—the idea that they could cause cancer is deeply unsettling and shareable.

title: The Doctor Who Deliberately Infected Children With Syphilis—Then Watched Them Die
hook: He wanted to study 'the natural progression' of the disease, so he injected it into healthy kids.
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of children + syphilis + deliberate infection is one of the most morally outrageous stories possible.
